title: Model Evidence Command Centre & Scientific Validation
based_on: AGROLATTICE 11.13 — Experiment Command Centre & Trial Intelligence
database_migration: Research Evidence is upgraded additively from schema 1.3.0 to 2.0.0 with a pre-11.14 predecessor copy and integrity/foreign-key/row-preservation verification.
headline_features: Persistent training runs for successful, inferior and failed candidate models.
Immutable model versions with artifact SHA-256, computational environment and feature contract.
Auditable evidence-gated model promotion and model-health history.
Predictive explainability with artifact integrity checks.
Registry-native model disagreement with invalid ensemble guards.
Local benchmark execution with explicit official/approximate split status.
Dataset snapshots and downloadable model reproducibility packages.
Validation split preview and repeated group-isolated stability diagnostics.
Probability-aware classification metrics and confusion matrices.
Applicability/drift monitoring and paired bootstrap model-difference uncertainty.
Automatic training dataset snapshot manifests and richer feature/environment contracts.
Stricter Prototype-first registration and external-evidence promotion gates.
limitations: Full interactive browser verification requires the target Streamlit environment.
Official benchmark retrieval is not automated because dataset size/licence/upstream schemas vary.
Learned stacking/ensemble weights are not automatically promoted without a nested/OOF meta-training design.
Generic SHAP support remains backend/model dependent.
Prediction-outcome matching requires researcher review and does not establish causality.
